WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.405425 38.70907)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1000 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

```sql
WITH uni_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.405425 38.70907)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elev_rast AS (
  SELECT rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    rast,
    ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.405425 38.70907)'), 4326), 4326)
  )
),
filtered_cells AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(rast, true, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(uni_geom.geom, 4326), 10000, 'quad_segs=8')))).geom AS cell_geom,
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(rast, true, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(uni_geom.geom, 4326), 10000, 'quad_segs=8')))).val AS elevation
  FROM elev_rast, uni_geom
),
above_1000 AS (
  SELECT cell_geom
  FROM filtered_cells
  WHERE elevation > 1000
),
nearest_cell AS (
  SELECT ST_Distance(uni_geom.geom, cell_geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM uni_geom, above_1000
  ORDER BY distance_meters
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT distance_meters AS distance_to_nearest_cell_above_1000m
FROM nearest_cell;
```
